title: Under-deck vertical tuned mass damper at midspan on bolted clamp frame with staged install
problem_restatement: 40 m footbridge first vertical mode at 1.9 Hz lies in walking range with low damping and exceeds comfort under crowd loading, requiring concealed supplemental damping with staged retrofit without full closure
mechanism_sentence: A 500 kg weight hung on tuned springs and dampers under the middle of the bridge sways to calm crowd shaking to a gentle feel.
decisive_choices: Mount 500 kg tuned mass at midspan under deck tuned just below 1.9 Hz to 1.85 Hz
Support on helical springs plus viscous dashpots sized for 72.3 mm sag and 20.1 mm crowd stroke with plus-minus 50 mm stops
Clamp with bolted transverse bearers with staged night install and removable cover for re-tuning without deck change
open_question: Will field-measured first-mode frequency, modal mass and damping confirm the assumed 20000 kg at 1.9 Hz tuning so dense-crowd response stays below 1.0 m/s2 with clearance?
transfer_line: Load: pedestrians -> deck -> damper mass | Measured: deck acceleration -> comfort check

assumed_constraints.constraint: vertical comfort target maximum comfort below 0.5 m/s2, minimum comfort below 1.0 m/s2, unacceptable above 2.5 m/s2 per Setra and HiVoSS comfort classes

staged night installation plus under-bridge access: prefabricate frame plus TMD off site, lift from tower plus under-bridge inspection platform with one lane kept open, lock mass for transport and release after bolting, leave removable cover plus shim and threaded spring seats for inspection and re-tuning

dense-crowd verification case Class III 0.5 pedestrians per square metre, equivalent synchronized pedestrians from Setra 10.8*sqrt(zeta*N), single-pedestrian weight 700 N with 280 N first-harmonic amplitude at resonance

functional_decomposition: Quantify first vertical mode modal mass, stiffness and damping of 40 m span
Suppress first vertical mode resonant response with supplemental damping
Concealed under-deck mounting, staged installation without full closure, and inspection plus re-tuning access for 40 m span
Verify pedestrian comfort against crowd loading for 40 m span

concept.working_principle: lumped steel mass on helical steel springs plus viscous dashpots, tuned to first vertical mode, mounted at midspan under deck so deck appearance unchanged

parts.name: existing 40 m footbridge deck and girders
parts.function: carry pedestrian load and provide first vertical mode at 1.9 Hz

parts.name: transverse steel bearer beams
parts.function: clamp to existing longitudinal girders to carry TMD without welding

parts.name: TMD steel mass 500 kg
parts.function: secondary tuned mass to absorb first vertical mode

parts.name: helical steel springs
parts.function: provide tuned stiffness with static sag and re-tuning adjustment

parts.name: viscous dashpots
parts.function: provide tuned damping for resonant energy dissipation

parts.name: removable under-deck cover
parts.function: conceal TMD and allow inspection and re-tuning access

parts.name: preloaded high-strength bolts
parts.function: clamp bearer beams to girders without welding

loads.label: dense-crowd resonant force 1480 N on deck

key_estimates.quantity: total spring compression static plus dynamic

fabrication_steps.description: Build the two steel bearer beams and the 500 kg damper unit with springs and dampers off site
Lift the unit under the middle of the bridge at night from a tower platform keeping one walkway open and clamp the beams to the girders with preloaded bolts
Unlock the mass for operation, fit the removable cover below and set the spring seats and shims for tuning
Inspect the unit from below and re-tune with shims if shaking grows
